programme.title: Licence mention Informatique (entry year: L1 Portail Mathématiques, Informatique (MI))
programme.quote: Elle démarre par une année de portail mathématiques-informatique en L1, se concentre sur l’informatique à partir de la L2, et s’achève par la délivrance d’un diplôme national de Licence d’Informatique (180 ECTS).
programme.how_found: site-restricted web search (universite-paris-saclay.fr) for 'Licence Informatique Université Paris-Saclay L1 Orsay'; Licence Informatique mention page links to L1 Portail MI page, whose 'Langue d'enseignement' fields read 'Français' and 'Lieu(x) d'enseignement' read BURES SUR YVETTE / ORSAY. 'Informatique' is the official French name of the computer science licence; first-year entry is through the bi-disciplinary MI portal.

value.description: Programme taught in French; the university says a minimum French level is required but publishes no specific CEFR level or score for L1 via Études en France/DAP.

english.quote: A minimum level of French is required in order to enroll in a study program taught in French
english.how_found: Searched universite-paris-saclay.fr for French-level requirements for L1 international applicants; checked L1 MI page, international first-cycle page, English undergraduate application page and the Learning French page.
english.notes: Programme is French-taught, so the language requirement is French, not English; no IELTS/TOEFL requirement. No Paris-Saclay page read states a numeric French level (e.g. B2) for L1 DAP applicants; the university's Learning French page names TEF/DELF/DALF without a level and says requirements vary by institution. A B2 level is commonly cited for the national DAP but was not found on an allowed source, so it is not recorded. The L1 MI page lists 'Langue d'enseignement: Français' on its course units.

value.description: No published grade/average threshold. L1 admission is via national platform dossier review (Parcoursup for French/EU bac holders; DAP via Études en France for non-EU applicants abroad) against stated prerequisites; capacity 90 places.

gpa.quote: Public visé et prérequis Bachelier.ère.s avec un bon niveau en mathématiques.
gpa.how_found: Admission tab of the L1 Portail MI programme page.
gpa.notes: Page states 'Capacité d’accueil Places 90'. Only a qualitative prerequisite ('good level in mathematics'); no minimum average or test score is published. For non-EU applicants abroad the international page says a Demande d'Admission Préalable (via Études en France) is required.

deadline.quote: DAP- Demande d’admission préalable Début des inscriptions 1er octobre 2026 Clôture des inscriptions 15 décembre 2026
deadline.how_found: The university's international first-cycle page (https://www.universite-paris-saclay.fr/admissions/etudiants-internationaux-candidater-en-premier-cycle-licences) tells non-EU applicants residing in an Études en France country to use that procedure and links to the Campus France page campusfrance.org/fr/candidature-procedure-etudes-en-france, which gives the 2027/2028 DAP calendar.
deadline.notes: National Campus France page used because the Paris-Saclay page links to it; Paris-Saclay itself only says the DAP must be made 'entre les mois de novembre et de janvier précédant l’année universitaire'. The Campus France calendar is headed 'Si vous souhaitez intégrer l'enseignement supérieur pour l'année 2027/2028'. Kazakhstan has an Espace Campus France (listed on campusfrance.org/fr/espaces, also linked from the university page), so the Études en France/DAP route applies; the L1 MI page's Parcoursup window (19 Jan–12 Mar 2026) is for French/EU bac holders and the 2026 cycle. Confirm with Campus France Kazakhstan.

value.population: non-EU (after Paris-Saclay partial exemption of differentiated fees; same as national rate)

tuition.quote: les étudiants extra-communautaires concernés par les droits différenciés bénéficient d’une exonération partielle. Celle-ci porte les montants des "droits différenciés" aux montants des droits applicables aux étudiants nationaux
tuition.how_found: Fees page linked from the international first-cycle page ('page des tarifs').
tuition.notes: Same page: 'Pour l’année 2026-2027, les droits d’inscription sont fixés comme suit :' with table 'Cursus Licence 178 €'. 2027/28 fees not yet published; 2026/27 is latest. Exemption applies 'dans les conditions fixées par la délibération n° CA-2026-013 du CA du 3 février 2026', which was not read (hosted on a cirrus file-share). CVEC (student life contribution, paid to CROUS) is extra and not included.

scholarship_exists.quote: Afin de promouvoir l’ouverture internationale de ses formations de master (Diplôme National), l’Université Paris-Saclay propose un programme de bourses internationales afin de faciliter l’accueil d’excellents étudiants étrangers
scholarship_exists.how_found: Programme page menu 'Bourses et aides financières' -> 'Les bourses d'études et de formation' -> list of scholarship programmes.
scholarship_exists.notes: Every university-run study scholarship listed is for master/doctorate (Bourses internationales de master, Eiffel, LPDP, Sophie Germain, Erasmus Mundus, etc.) or starts at L3 (Mathématique au Féminin). The only licence-level item is the 'Bourse FMJHCare de mobilité entrante' from the Fondation Mathématique Jacques Hadamard, a separate foundation, for 'Licences ou Masters de mathématiques' (not computer science); its page is on fondation-hadamard.fr and was not read. No university-run scholarship for incoming international L1 computer science students was found.

scholarship_international.notes: Not applicable because no qualifying bachelor scholarship exists. The page's general statement says scholarships target 'étudiants (français ou internationaux) de haut niveau académique', but the international programmes listed are master-level.
